expects: explains DPS is legacy PCR2015 (abolished prospectively, deemed to end Feb 2029); dynamic market is new PA2023 (ss34–40), permanently open, awards via competitive flexible procedure only; BOTH bar direct award / call-off without further competition — awards require a competition; does NOT conflate these with framework call-offs; correctly uses 'competitive flexible procedure' for dynamic markets and 'further competition / mini-competition' for DPS
